visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, dressed in a pale pink long-sleeved athletic shirt, runs towards a handheld camera at night. Her face is centered in the frame, exhibiting energetic micro-expressions and moving lips as she speaks. The background is a dark, expansive outdoor park area with distant city lights and blurred silhouettes of foliage under low-key artificial lighting. White subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) The camera maintains a shaky selfie-perspective as the woman continues her rhythmic running motion. Her hands are partially visible gripping the smartphone recording the scene. The lighting is dominated by a cool-toned glow on her face, while the path behind her remains shrouded in deep shadows with small bokeh light points from street lamps far in the distance. (3) The woman's facial expression shifts from informative to intense exertion. Suddenly, a man with light-dyed hair and a dark shirt emerges from the shadows directly behind her, mimicking her running stride. The woman looks back with wide eyes and an open-mouthed expression of terror, her body posture tensing as she increases her speed. The background remains the dimly lit, paved running path.
